title: Accounts Receivable Rule: Payment Standing Share on the Final Electricity Overage Charge
content:
# Final Electricity Standing Share — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Rule.** A final electricity standing share applies to the final electricity overage line of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account:

- **0.95** when the Apartment Home Lease is enrolled in rent autopay and at least 12 utility payments were received fewer than twelve whole months before the billing date;
- **0.97** when at least 12 utility payments were received in that time and the lease is not enrolled in autopay;
- the **whole charge** otherwise.

The share multiplies the line's charge, which is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. Utility payments are the payments received on the utility account.

## Combinations

| Rent autopay | Utility payments in twelve months | Share |
|---|---|---|
| enrolled | 12 or more | 0.95 |
| enrolled | 11 or fewer | whole |
| not enrolled | 12 or more | 0.97 |
| not enrolled | 11 or fewer | whole |

*Worked case (hypothetical charge of $25.50):* 0.95 gives $24.225, which is $24.23 at the end; 0.97 gives $24.735, which is $24.74.
